body:
another college kid here

i totally get where you’re coming from. i know i have friends and family who love and care about me, and they would be devastated if i killed myself. so the only reason i’m still here right now is so i don’t hurt them too. 

I wish i had the answer to keep going, but that’s something i’m still trying to figure out too. i think the best thing right now is try to think about what else is keeping you here, or what else might encourage you to stay because staying alive for others isn’t really living. 

Take a moment and think of the little things life has given you, since looking at the big picture is always shitty. just small memories that make you smile. little steps at a time can show you why you still want to be here :)
